d: What an AI's first pass is, until a person reads it aloud and signs it
n: A draft is a first pass that is not yet anyone's word. An AI writes drafts well and fast; the person who sends one is its author, and the cut is where the authorship happens. Treat every AI page as a draft until you have read it aloud, removed what you would never say, and put your name on what is left.
